cli.about: Flash official Xiaomi Recovery ROMs over direct USB
cli.long_about: Sensitivity is a direct-USB Xiaomi Recovery flash and rescue tool. It does not require ADB, an unlocked bootloader, or proprietary Xiaomi desktop software.
